title: Apple paid Ireland $17 billion last year as EU back-tax case came due - 9to5Mac
summary: The Financial Times reports that new tax disclosures showed Apple paid Ireland $17 billion in corporate income taxes in 2025, accounting for 40% of its worldwide total. Check out 9to5Mac on YouTube for more Apple news: Breaking news from Cupertino.
